title: Gus Lamont’s parents make emotional plea as $1m reward offered for information about disappearance
summary_full: No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s South Australian farm on 27 September last yearThe parents of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont have made an emotional plea for any information about their “unique little boy” as authorities offered a $1m reward over the disappearance.No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s enormous sheep farm in the South Australian outback almost a year ago.
